stem.en: Which pair gives one advantage and one disadvantage of settling near a river?

text.en: Advantage: fresh silt on the fields. Disadvantage: floods at unreliable times.
Advantage: fresh silt on the fields. Disadvantage: water for the crops.

feedback.en: Water for crops is an advantage, so this pair names two advantages.

text.en: Advantage: floods at unreliable times. Disadvantage: boats can carry goods.

feedback.en: These are the wrong way round: floods are the danger, and boats are the benefit.

text.en: Advantage: salt building up in the soil. Disadvantage: fertile land.

feedback.en: These are the wrong way round: salt harms the soil, and fertile land is the benefit.

explanation.en: Rivers gave water, fertile soil and transport. They also brought floods, moving channels and, with irrigation in a dry land, salt in the soil.

hints.en: Decide for each phrase whether it helps or harms farmers.
